note.summary:
3.2 Media and technology
Key focus
- social media, online safety, devices, communication and digital habits.

Core language
- Useful structures: मेरे विचार में; मुझे ... पसंद है क्योंकि; पिछले साल; अगली बार; आम तौर पर; मुझे ... चाहिए।
- Use negatives carefully, give advantages and drawbacks, and distinguish direct speech from reported opinions.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: मैं फ़ोन से दोस्तों से बात करता हूँ और समय-सारिणी देखता हूँ।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

I use my phone to talk to friends and look at timetables.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: मेरी बहन रोज़ तीन घंटे सोशल मीडिया पर बिताती है, शायद बहुत ज़्यादा।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

My sister spends three hours a day on social media, perhaps too much.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.

questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

Yesterday I downloaded an app that helps me learn vocabulary.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.

Translate into Hindi:

questions.modelAnswer: वीडियो कॉल सुविधाजनक है, लेकिन असली मुलाक़ात की जगह नहीं ले सकती।

Translate into Hindi:

questions.modelAnswer: कल मैं अपना पासवर्ड बदलूँगा और सभी कार्यक्रम अपडेट करूँगा।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

Tomorrow I will change my password and update all programs.

questions.examTip: Cover every bullet, use past and future forms where relevant, and justify opinions with क्योंकि.
questions.modelAnswer:
मैं फ़ोन से दोस्तों से बात करता हूँ और समय-सारिणी देखता हूँ। मेरी बहन रोज़ तीन घंटे सोशल मीडिया पर बिताती है, शायद बहुत ज़्यादा। कल मैंने एक ऐप डाउनलोड किया जो मुझे शब्दावली सीखने में मदद करता है। मेरे विचार में यह महत्वपूर्ण है और भविष्य में मैं एक नया अनुभव लेना चाहूँगा।

(English translation: I use my phone to talk to friends and look at timetables. My sister spends three hours a day on social media, perhaps too much. Yesterday I downloaded an app that helps me learn vocabulary. In my opinion it is important, and in the future I would like to have a new experience.)
